description: This file defines the SubscriptionStatus class in the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing subscription status data, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving subscription status records and their descriptions from the database.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: A model class for managing subscription statuses in OpenCart, providing methods for CRUD operations, retrieving lists and descriptions, and handling localization data.

methods.name: addSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Creates a new subscription status record in the database, for each language provided, and clears the subscription status cache.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Edits an existing subscription status by deleting the previous record(s) and adding new descriptions, then clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Deletes a subscription status record from the database based on its ID and clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteStockStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all subscription statuses associated with a specific language ID and clears the cache.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription status record by its ID, filtered by current language.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscription statuses, possibly filtered, sorted, and paginated, with caching.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscription status records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a description record for a subscription status in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all subscription status descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a subscription status for a specified ID and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Gets all descriptions associated with a specific subscription status ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions of subscription statuses in a specific language.
